description: This file defines the EmployeeImmigrationRecordDecorator class, which acts as a decorator for the EmployeeImmigrationRecord entity, providing additional methods for formatting dates, retrieving related data such as country names, and setting associated employee entities by employee number in the context of the OrangeHRM system.

classes.name: EmployeeImmigrationRecordDecorator
classes.description: A decorator class that extends the functionality of the EmployeeImmigrationRecord entity, adding methods for date formatting, country name retrieval, and setting associated employee entity by employee number.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the decorator with an EmployeeImmigrationRecord instance.

methods.name: getEmployeeImmigrationRecord
methods.description: Protected method that returns the encapsulated EmployeeImmigrationRecord instance.

methods.name: setEmployeeByEmpNumber
methods.description: Associates an Employee entity to the immigration record based on the provided employee number.

methods.name: getIssuedDate
methods.description: Returns the issued date of the immigration record formatted as a string.

methods.name: getExpiryDate
methods.description: Returns the expiry date of the immigration record formatted as a string.

methods.name: getReviewDate
methods.description: Returns the review date of the immigration record formatted as a string.

methods.name: getCountryName
methods.description: Fetches and returns the country name associated with the immigration record's country code.

methods.name: getDocumentType
methods.description: Returns the mapped document type string based on the record's type field.
